name: motif
description: Create portable Motif workbenches from biological sequence records supplied by the user.

interface.longDescription: Create a local, self-contained Motif HTML workbench from exact DNA, RNA, protein, FASTA, GenBank, or Motif JSON supplied by the user. The resulting file can be opened and edited in a browser and shared intentionally. Motif does not retrieve missing records, run remote analyses, validate experiments, or modify external systems.
defaultPrompt: Create a Motif workbench for this FASTA file and open the resulting HTML for me.
Put these supplied DNA and protein records into one portable Motif workbench.
Create a Motif HTML workbench from this GenBank file without changing its records.
